meta.name: paraphrase_probe_queries_en
meta.purpose: Measure the same 'rephrase and you can't find it' phenomenon in English: each query replaces a literal phrase of the target document with a synonym / colloquial / hypernym wording; avoid_terms records the replaced original phrase. Isomorphic to the Chinese probe (eval/paraphrase/queries.json).
meta.authoring: Hand-authored English analogy of the Chinese probe; no model generation, no templates.
meta.gold_definition: gold_doc = the single corpus document that answers the query (by filename). Does NOT reuse Holdout B questions or gold.
selfcheck: A. each avoid_term must appear verbatim in gold_doc (otherwise it is not a 'document literal phrase' and the label is invalid)
B. each avoid_term must NOT appear in the query (otherwise it is not a paraphrase)
C. at runtime, per-query lexical_candidates are also recorded, to prove literal overlap is actually broken
